title: Teach the Magnitude, Not the Direction: Verifier-Bounded Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn Multi-step LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.13179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) offers a verifier-bounded performance ceiling for training multi-turn tool-use agents, yet its trajectory-level credit assignment conflates heterogeneous per-turn outcomes into a single reward signal. On-policy distillation provides dense per-token supervision but is either teacher-bounded or prone to gradient concentration collapse. We introduce $\textbf{CrEST}$, a hierarchical credit assignment framework that retains RL's verifier-bounded ceiling while incorporating dense token-level signals from a privileged self-teacher. $\textbf{CrEST}$ resolves credit at two levels: turn-segmented verified advantages address inter-turn dilution, while entropy-gated self-teacher modulation refines intra-turn token contributions. translated_title: 教授大小，而非方向：面向多轮多步LLM智能体的验证器受限信用分配
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13179v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为训练多轮工具使用智能体设定了验证器受限的性能上限，但其轨迹级信用分配将异构的每轮结果混为一谈，汇集成单一奖励信号。在线策略蒸馏提供了密集的逐令牌监督，但要么受限于教师模型，要么容易导致梯度集中崩溃。我们引入了$\textbf{CrEST}$，一种层次化信用分配框架，它保留了RL的验证器受限上限，同时融入了来自特权自教师模型的密集令牌级信号。$\textbf{CrEST}$在两个层面解决信用分配问题：轮次分割的验证优势应对轮间稀释，而熵门控的自教师调制细化轮内令牌贡献。在BFCL V3和WildToolBench上的实验表明，$\textbf{CrEST}$在两种模型规模上均持续优于RL和蒸馏基线，其中最大规模的优势最为显著。
tldr: CrEST通过层次化信用分配框架，结合验证器受限的强化学习上限和自教师模型的密集令牌信号，有效解决了多轮LLM智能体训练中的信用分配问题，在基准测试中持续超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: CrEST introduces a hierarchical credit assignment framework that combines verifier-bounded RL ceilings with dense token-level signals from a self-teacher, effectively addressing credit allocation in multi-turn LLM agents and consistently outperforming baselines.
